 Jess Anderson
 Show Most recent Most popular Post published at 52 mins 52 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 A controversial decision.
 Thomas Bramall says that James McAtee takes a touch to take the ball away from goal. If he does, it's only a very small one.
 Ipswich still have XI on the pitch. On we go.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 NO RED CARD published at 51 mins 51 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Referee Thomas Bramall has a good long look at the monitor but he opts for a booking and a free-kick.
 He explains they feel James McAtee was going away from goal.
 125 203 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 50 mins 50 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 It looks to me like James McAtee is cleaned out and he's the last man.
 Issa Diop races across and thunders in. Is it a denial of a goalscoring opportunity? That is the question.
 105 70 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Video Assistant Referee published at 49 mins 49 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Hello...VAR are looking at this.
 Is it a red card? The referee is being sent to the monitor.
 104 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 48 mins 48 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Goodness me. That looks like a desperate challenge from Issa Diop on James McAtee, who was powering away.
 But the referee doesn't even give a free-kick, never mind reach for his pocket. Forest are fuming.
 60 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 47 mins 47 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Nottingham Forest have lost just one of their last 19 Premier League matches in which they've scored first (W14 D4), though that defeat did come in their last away game against Crystal Palace.
 34 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 KICK-OFF published at 21:04 BST 21:04 BST 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Image source, Getty Images Off we go with the second half.
 No changes at the break.
 72 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:03 BST 21:03 BST 
 HT: Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Ipswich Town 
 Ipswich captain Dara O'Shea tells Sky Sports at half time that the players are struggling with the windy conditions in a "tough game".
 He might want to get in that dressing room and change his shirt. It's a bit cold to have the shoulders out.
 70 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:59 BST 20:59 BST 
 HT: Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Nottingham Forest have conceded 3 goals in the last 15 minutes of the first half, only Newcastle United (5) have conceded more in the Premier League this season.
 Unfortunately for them, Ipswich have a habit of scoring late, too.
 83 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:55 BST 20:55 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Good game for a Friday night.
 Phil, Colechester 
 131 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:53 BST 20:53 BST 
 HT: Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 An entertaining game so far.
 Feels like it could go either way at this point, doesn't it?
 Image source, Getty Images 
 104 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 20:49 BST 20:49 BST 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Forest with a good start and Neco Williams rewarding their efforts but a gift from the visitors leaves us all square at the break.
 120 47 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45+2 mins 45+2 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Dara O'Shea's shirt is looking a bit worse for wear after he goes up for the ball with Liam Delap.
 He's now sporting a lovely off-shoulder number.
 136 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:47 BST 20:47 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Seeing how this game has been so far I’m expecting a great relegation fight this year! No one looks like going down!
 Rufus, Haddenham 
 164 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'That was a gift' published at 20:47 BST 20:47 BST 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 We did say there might be mistakes but that is a big mistake and a gift for Julio Enciso. 
 A real poor pass form Nikola Milenkovic - that is a brilliant finish but a real disappointment for Forest. 
 162 71 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 A shake of the head from Nikola Milenkovic. A big mistake from the centre back after his side had seemed well on top.
 124 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest published at 20:42 BST 20:42 BST 
 Julio Enciso (41 mins) 
 Image source, Getty Images A big error!
 A really poor pass from Nikola Milenkovic back towards his goalkeeper and Haddenham is all over it, he chases the ball down and only has the keeper to beat, slotting into the bottom corner.
 A gift.
 993 535 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:36 BST 20:36 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Forest have started strong
 Sarah, Liverpool 
 256 192 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 35 mins 35 mins 
 Ipswich 0-1 Nottm Forest 
 Image source, Getty Images Forest just look so dangerous every time they come forward.
 The visitors have pinged 10 balls into the box compared to Ipswich's one.
 207 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 Ipswich 0-1 Nottm Forest 
 Forest win back-to-back corners. Two good deliveries and the second almost results in a goal as Dan Ndoye's close-range header almost catches Christian Walton out at his near post.
